name: com.midmanstudio.dragndrop
description: Framework-agnostic drag-and-drop core: a single DragDropController state machine that a uGUI adapter or a UI Toolkit adapter feeds identically, so unrelated systems (inventory slots, the chemistry bench's reagent tray, HudMan's HUD layout editor, anything else) can share one drag interaction layer without depending on each other. Zero game-specific logic, and the Core assembly stays deliberately zero-.mdix and zero-UnityEngine dependent -- there's no static catalog to drive here, just runtime interaction state. 0.2.0 adds the first concrete adapter: Runtime/UGUI, a small uGUI/EventSystems layer (DragDropControllerHost, UGuiDraggableSource, UGuiDropTargetZone) that any RectTransform-based UI can drop onto without hand-rolling IBeginDragHandler/IDragHandler/IEndDragHandler again. The UI Toolkit adapter is still unbuilt.
